skill.name: generate-image
skill.description: Generate or edit photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, and presentation assets with OpenRouter image models. Use a schematic-focused skill for technical diagrams.
skill.summary: Generate and edit visual assets with OpenRouter image models, custom prompts, optional source images, and local output files.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The skill sends prompts and optional input images to OpenRouter, then writes generated image data to a selected local path. Most external-command alerts are Markdown formatting, and most key alerts reference placeholders or ordinary parameter handling. Parent credential discovery, command-line secrets, image uploads, and unrestricted output paths need stronger consent and scope controls.

remediation.issue: Credential discovery searches every parent directory.
remediation.suggestion: Read OPENROUTER_API_KEY from the process environment or an explicit project file. Do not traverse above the workspace root.

remediation.issue: The --api-key option can expose credentials through command history and process listings.
remediation.suggestion: Remove command-line secret input. Use the process environment, protected standard input, or an approved secret manager.

remediation.issue: Editing uploads local image contents to OpenRouter without a separate confirmation step.
remediation.suggestion: Show the selected path and destination, then require user confirmation before uploading an input image.

remediation.issue: The output path is opened in write mode and can replace an existing file.
remediation.suggestion: Reject existing paths by default. Require an explicit overwrite option and validate that the destination is inside the approved workspace.

content.user_title: Generate and Edit Images with OpenRouter
content.value_statement: Creating polished visual assets can require separate tools and model-specific workflows. This skill generates or edits images through OpenRouter and saves the result locally.
actual_capabilities: Sends text prompts to a selected OpenRouter image model.
Encodes a local input image for model-assisted editing.
Supports Gemini and FLUX model identifiers described by the skill.
Accepts custom input, output, and model selections through command-line options.
Handles two OpenRouter response layouts and saves the first returned image.
Accepts PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP files as editing inputs.
limitations: Requires the Python requests package, an OpenRouter API key, and network access.
Prompts and editing images leave the local machine, and provider charges may apply.
Only the first returned image is saved, and remote image URLs are not downloaded.
Model availability, output quality, and generation time depend on OpenRouter and the selected model.

use_cases.title: Create Concept Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate focused artwork or photorealistic references for early design exploration.

use_cases.title: Illustrate Research Materials
use_cases.description: Create nontechnical concept images for presentations, posters, and explanatory documents.

use_cases.title: Adapt Existing Assets
use_cases.description: Change backgrounds, colors, objects, or styling while preserving requested source elements.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a [style] image of [subject]. Save it to [output path].
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with a clear subject and one visual style.

prompt_templates.title: Control Composition
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate [subject] with [lighting], [camera angle], [color palette], and [background]. Save it to [output path].
prompt_templates.scenario: Specify the main visual controls for a polished result.

prompt_templates.title: Edit an Existing Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit [input image] by changing [target detail] to [desired result]. Preserve [unchanged elements] and save to [output path].
prompt_templates.scenario: Make a targeted change while protecting important source details.

prompt_templates.title: Direct an Advanced Edit
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit [input image] with [model], preserve [elements], change [details], and save to [output path]. Do not alter [protected elements].
prompt_templates.scenario: Control the model, output, modifications, and preservation constraints.

output_examples.input: Create a clean editorial photograph of a ceramic lamp on a white studio background.
output_examples.output: The skill requests the image and saves the first returned result as the selected PNG file.

output_examples.input: Change the background of product.jpg to pale gray while preserving the product colors.
output_examples.output: The source image is sent with the edit request, and the returned image is saved to the selected path.

output_examples.input: Create a scientific concept illustration of immune cells approaching a tumor.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a conceptual illustration for review, not a precise technical or diagnostic diagram.

best_practices: Review prompts and input images for sensitive information before sending them to OpenRouter.
Use explicit output paths and confirm that existing files may be replaced.
Choose a model after checking its current availability, capabilities, and pricing.
anti_patterns: Do not pass API keys on the command line or include them in prompts.
Do not upload confidential images without authorization and provider review.
Do not use this skill for precise technical diagrams or regulated visual evidence.

faq.question: Does this skill require an OpenRouter account?
faq.answer: Yes. Image requests require a valid OpenRouter API key and may incur provider charges.

faq.question: Are prompts and images processed locally?
faq.answer: No. Prompts and editing images are sent to OpenRouter, while returned image data is saved locally.

faq.question: Which input image formats are supported?
faq.answer: The script recognizes PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP extensions for image editing.

faq.question: Can I select a different model?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide an OpenRouter model identifier, but verify current generation and editing support first.

faq.question: Can this skill create technical diagrams?
faq.answer: It can create conceptual visuals, but a schematic-focused skill is better for precise technical diagrams.

faq.question: Can the output replace an existing file?
faq.answer: Yes. The current script opens the selected output path in write mode without an overwrite prompt.
